'''''MedStar Four''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[MedStar-class frigate/Legends|''MedStar''-class frigate]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], it was commanded by Commander [[Hotise]] and was stationed above the planet [[Despayre]], supporting the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] construction project.
